stories.title: Bank of Russia lowers dollar exchange rate for August 20 to 85.13 rubles
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 19. The Bank of Russia set the official US dollar exchange rate for August 20, 2026, at 85.1293 rubles, down 3.52 kopecks from the previous rate. The official euro exchange rate was lowered by 18.55 kopecks to 98.5457 rubles. The official yuan exchange rate was raised by 0.61 kopecks to 12.6301 rubles.
